controls.title: Versioned security policy, separation of duties and quarterly review
controls.automated_test: evidence connector checks current approval and overdue actions

controls.title: Owned risk register with scoring, treatment and expiry
controls.automated_test: opencoding-compliance validates owner, score, treatment, due date and status

controls.title: SSO, MFA, least privilege, joiner-mover-leaver and access review
controls.evidence_artifact: MFA policy, membership changes, deprovision latency, review decisions
controls.automated_test: IdP connector rejects missing MFA and reports overdue or orphaned access

controls.title: Protected branch, independent review, required CI and reviewed source release
controls.evidence_artifact: branch rules, PR review, checks, reviewed source tag and release run
controls.automated_test: SCM connector verifies branch policy and source release workflow gates an existing reviewed tag

controls.title: Task to approved diff, commit, build and source release chain
controls.evidence_artifact: Team/task/session trailers, diff hash, commit OID, tests, audit IDs and source release tag
controls.automated_test: combined Git/Draft-PR fixture and source release contract

controls.title: SAST, dependency, secret, license and artifact scanning with SLA
controls.evidence_artifact: scan SARIF, advisory result, license result, secret alerts and remediation ticket
controls.automated_test: CI fails applicable scan and security connector reports SLA breaches

controls.title: Tamper-evident management, authentication, policy and execution audit
controls.evidence_artifact: append-only scoped events and verified hash chain
controls.automated_test: startup chain verification and database mutation rejection tests

controls.title: Classified data flows, minimization, encryption, retention and deletion
controls.evidence_artifact: flow review, KMS rotation, deletion result, backup encryption and access logs
controls.automated_test: allowlist blocks unreviewed provider/runner/connector and retention monitor raises findings

controls.title: Severity, on-call, evidence preservation, notification and tabletop
controls.evidence_artifact: timeline, severity, responders, notification, postmortem and remediation
controls.automated_test: incident connector checks notification/SLA fields and overdue remediation

controls.title: Backup, restore verification, capacity, degradation and RPO/RTO
controls.evidence_artifact: integrity result, backup digest, restore result and exercise findings
controls.automated_test: SQLite online backup/offline restore and failed source rebuild preservation tests

controls.title: Vendor security review, DPA, subprocessor and renewal tracking
controls.evidence_artifact: review decision, DPA, subprocessor disclosure and renewal due date
controls.automated_test: vendor connector blocks expired/unapproved production allowlist entries

controls.title: Screening, confidentiality, training and timely offboarding
controls.automated_test: HR/IdP reconciliation flags missing training or delayed deprovision

controls.title: Security documentation, data processing, subprocessors and disclosure channel
controls.evidence_artifact: published version, approval, customer notification and questionnaire sources
controls.automated_test: trust-center connector checks freshness and material-change notification

risks.treatment: Provider allowlist, minimization, DPA and customer routing controls
OS sandbox, default network deny, boundary tests and microVM roadmap
Dependency/SAST/secret scanning, protected source tags and reproducible source validation
MFA, separate production grants, access review and IdP/HR reconciliation

exercises.evidence: tests/test-backup-restore.sh: live Team API write, online backup integrity verification, offline atomic restore and recovery-point API assertion
incident system exercise record with attendees, timeline and customer notification decision
